Container.Name: romarr
Container.Overview: ROMarr - Retro ROM acquisition and library manager. Prowlarr for indexers, supports No-Intro/Redump DAT verification, 1G1R and full-set management. Runs behind GluetunVPN kill-switch. Port must be published on GluetunVPN AND in FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS. NOTE: env vars are read-only on first start; configure API keys and paths in ROMarr Settings UI after first launch.
Container.Requires: GluetunVPN container running; port 6868 published on GluetunVPN; 6868 in GluetunVPN FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS

Config.Name: ROMs Library
Config.Description: ROM library root. Set LIBRARY_PATH to /roms and LIBRARY_KIND to folder.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Shared downloads path. Must match the path your download client (SABnzbd/Deluge) uses.

Config.Name: PROWLARR_URL
Config.Description: Prowlarr URL. Since both run behind GluetunVPN on the same network namespace, use localhost.

Config.Name: PROWLARR_API_KEY
Config.Description: Prowlarr API key. Find in Prowlarr Settings > General > API Key.

Config.Name: SABNZBD_URL
Config.Description: SABnzbd URL. Runs on same GluetunVPN network namespace.

Config.Name: SABNZBD_API_KEY
Config.Description: SABnzbd API key. Find in SABnzbd Config > General > API Key.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_KIND
Config.Description: Library mode: folder (use existing folder structure) or romm (RomM-compatible). Use folder unless you run RomM.

Config.Name: LIBRARY_PATH
Config.Description: Path inside container to ROM library root. Must match the ROMs Library volume mount target.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run as user ID (99 = nobody on Unraid)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run as group ID (100 = users on Unraid)

Config.Name: LOG_LEVEL
Config.Description: Log verbosity: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR
